scheduleName.description: Name of the location's schedule which determines when the selective accept is in effect.

callsFrom.description: Indicates whether to apply the selective accept criteria for calls from Any Phone Number, Select Phone Numbers or Forwarded ones.

anonymousCallersEnabled.description: When `true`, enables calls from anonymous callers. Value for this attribute is required if `callsFrom` is `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

unavailableCallersEnabled.description: When `true`, enables calls even if callers are unavailable. Value for this attribute is required if `callsFrom` is `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

phoneNumbers.description: the list of phone numbers that will checked against incoming calls for a match. Value for this attribute is required if `callsFrom` is `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS`.

acceptEnabled.description: Choose to accept (if `acceptEnabled` = `true`) or not to accept (if `acceptEnabled` = `false`) the calls that fit within these parameters.
